scripts.sync:build-schema: bun run --cwd packages/drizzle-sync build && bun packages/drizzle-sync/dist/cli.js build-schema --config ./drizzle-sync.config.ts
scripts.sync:generate: bun run sync:build-schema && bun packages/drizzle-sync/dist/cli.js generate --config ./drizzle-sync.config.ts
scripts.sync:validate: bun run --cwd packages/drizzle-sync build && bun packages/drizzle-sync/dist/cli.js validate --config ./drizzle-sync.config.ts
